drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 63-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.7, creatinine 0.77-1.05, hemoglobin 13.4-13.6, platelets 224-228, sodium 140, wbc 7.9-8.1; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 76-81, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 118-124, spo2 95-97, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.3-1.59, hemoglobin 13.5-13.6, platelets 222, sodium 140, wbc 7.5-8.1; vitals dbp 71-75, heart_rate 76-80, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 117-125, spo2 95-97, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 63-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
